scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && tsc -p tools --noEmit && tsc -p supabase/functions --noEmit

scripts.check:billing: npx -y deno@2.9.6 check --config tools/deno.json tools/billing-smoke.ts tools/billing-server-smoke.ts supabase/functions/billing/index.ts supabase/functions/billing-webhook/index.ts && npx -y deno@2.9.6 run --config tools/deno.json tools/billing-smoke.ts && npx -y deno@2.9.6 run --config tools/deno.json tools/billing-server-smoke.ts
